t: Din kos birkat hammazon, veshello yihyeh pagum
s: Din kos birkat hammazon, veshello yihyeh pagum, ubo v' seipim: yesh omerim shebbirkat hammazon teuna kos apillu beyachid, vetzarik lechazzer acharayv kederek shemmechazzerin achar kol mitzvot shehen choba. Velo yokal im en lo kos lebarek alayv umetzappeh sheyyihyeh lo achar kak, vaapillu im tzarik laabor zeman akila achat. Ulepi zeh, im shenayim okelim yachad — tzarik kol echad littol kos lebirkat hammazon. Mah sheen ken bishlosha shemmezammenim yachad — hambarek al hakkos motziam yede chobatam mehakkos, kemo shemmotziam mibbirkat hammazon. Veyesh omerim shebbirkat hammazon enah teuna kos ella keshemmebarekin bezimmun. Veyesh omerim sheapillu bishlosha o asara enah teuna kos lechoba, ella lemitzva min hammubchar im yesh lo, abal en tzarik lechazzer acharayv kederek shemmechazzerim achar hammitzvot shehen choba (veken nohagin akshav). Bammeh debarim amurim? Bezimmun, abal beyachid — en tzarik kos kelal ap lemitzva min hammubchar, vaapillu yesh lo. Veyesh medaqdeqim keshemmebarekim beyachid, lehanniach hakkos al hashshulchan velo leochzo beyado, kede latzet ledibre hakkol, shellehaomerim teuna kos apillu beyachid — hare hakkos lepanayv, vaachizato enah ella lemitzva min hammubchar ledibre hakkol. (Abal minhag haolam shello lebarek al hakkos kelal beyachid. Venakon minhag zeh al derek haqqabbala):

Kos birkat hammazon enah ella shel yayin velo shel shear mashqin, apillu qaba seudato alehem, shekkol kos shel beraka lo tiqnu ella miyyayin shehu "mesammeach eloqim vaanashim". Ubimqomot sheen hayyayin matzuy, vehashshekar o shear mashqin hem chamar medina, dehaynu sherob anshe hammaqom darkam liqboa alehem seudatam kemo sheqqobeim al hayyayin bimqomot shehu matzuy — mebarekim alehem birkat hammazon, ap al pi sheyyesh yayin bair. Vekol sheen yayin harbeh gadel kederek yom sebibot kol hair, apillu gadel meat samuk lair, vegam matzuy harbeh yayin bachanut — en zeh niqra matzuy, kevan shehu beyoqer, ubevadday en rob anshe hair qobeim tamid seudatam alayv. Umikkol maqom, mitzva min hammubchar lebarek al yayin. Vekol shekken im yesh lo yayin bebeto, sheen zeh hiddur kelal lebarek al shear mashqim, ella im ken yesh lo meat letzorek qiddush, sheqqiddush qodem lebirkat hammazon, mippene shehu taun kos ledibre hakkol. Veap sheepshar leqaddesh al happat, mikkol maqom, iqqar haqqiddush nitqan al hayyayin, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ra"a:

Vekol zeh bemashqim chashubim keshekar vekayyotze bo, abal mashqim geruim, kemo mah sheqqorin bimdinot ellu (qevava"s) o (barsh"t) — en lahem chashibut yoter mimmayim, veen mebarekim alehem birkat hammazon apillu bemaqom shedderek rob anshe hair liqboa seuda alehem, veen tzarik lomar qiddush vehabdala, lepi sheeno niqra chamar medina ella mah sheyyesh lo chashibut beotah medina keen chashibut yayin bekol hammedinot. Vaapillu eno shetiyyat rob anshe hair, ella shotin oto lipraqim bilbad mippene chashibuto, kemo (me"d) bimdinot ellu — lo nigra mippene zeh lebarek uleqaddesh alayv, kevan shezzehu mippene chashibuto, shehu chashub yoter min hashshekar, velaken rauy yoter lekos shel beraka min hashshekar, vegam hu chamar medina yoter mimmennu, kevan shechashub yoter, shehare kol maalat hayyayin lekos shel beraka eno ella mippene chashibuto, velo mippene shehu rob hashshetiyya bimqomot shehu matzuy larob, shehare ap bimqomot sheshshear mashqim hem rob hashshetiyya, ap al pi ken mitzva min hammubchar beyayin mippene chashibuto, im ken kol mashqeh shechashub yoter hu qarob leyayin yoter. Umah shennahagu hehamon kesheshshotin shekar basseuda veachar hasseuda qobeim atzmam lishtot me debash umebarekin birkat hammazon al hashshekar beomram shehu chamar medina — hu bizzuy mitzva, vehu biklal mah sheameru: "shello yehe shulchaneka male veshulchan rabbeka reqam". Veod, kevan shemme debash chabib alayv mehashshekar — hu muqdam libraka, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ry"a:

Kos shel beraka tzarik shello yehe pagum, sheim shata mimmennu — pegamo. Vaapillu lo hiqrib elayv et piv, ella shapak letok piv. Abal im shapak mimmennu letok yado o letok keli veshata — en bekak kelum. Vehu shello shapak ella meat, beinyan sheadayin shem male alayv, o sheachar kak shepako letok kos qatan mimmennu vehu male, o shezzoreq letoko ezeh dabar lehagbiah hayyayin sheyyehe hakkos male, sheeno tzarik lihyot male kullo miyyayin, ki day birbiit, raq shello yihyeh chaser. Vaapillu shata mehakkad o mechabit shel cheres shehi qetanna — nipgam kol hayyayin shebbahem. Abal im shata mechabit shel etz shehi gedola — en lehaqpid. Veyesh machamirin. Veyesh lachosh ledibrehem lekattechilla, shello lehanniach lishtot apillu mippi barza mechabit gedola:

Kos pagum yekolim letaqqeno al yede sheyyosipu alayv meat yayin, sheiqqar happigum mishshum sheshshata mimmennu, ukeshechozer umosip alayv — mittaqqen bekak, kemo pegimat hammizbeach shemmittaqqen im chozer vesotemo. Veken im hechezir yayin shebbekos pagum laqqanqan — nitbattel betoko berob vekasher. Umikkol maqom, en laasot ken, velaken nohagim lehosip alayv meat mehaqqanqan ubazeh mittaqqen, veachar kak shopekim oto letok haqqanqan, vechozerim umotziim oto mehaqqanqan leshem beraka, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman qp"g:

Apillu al yede meat mayim sheyyosipu alayv — mittaqqen, ben yayin ben shear mashqim shehem chamar medina, im i epshar letaqqenam beminam. Vehu, sheenam mitqalqelim mechamat hammayim ad sheenam reuyim lishtiyya. Vekos yayin, apillu yesh lo od yayin — yakol letaqqeno al yede mayim kol sheeno meqalqelo bekak, shehare regilim lemozgo bemayim. Veim hammayim hem pegumim — pesulim apillu limzog bahem yayin sheeno pagum, sheen hammayim mitbattelim bayyayin berob, hoil vetaam hammayim nirgash bayyayin, sheyyayin mazug eno shaveh betaamo lesheeno mazug. Ubishat haddechaq, sheen lo lo yayin velo mayim — mutab lebarek al kos pagum millebarek belo kos kelal, bimqomot sheshshear mashqim enam chamar medina, o sheen lo:
